text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Hey! It's back again!
You're not getting away this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
また出てきた！
今度は逃がさないんだからね！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: I-is it just me, or does something about it feel different this time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも……
さっきとは何か違うような……？

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
This isn't good. Watch out!
Foggy's absorbed the magical power from its surroundings!
It's even more powerful than before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかあれは……
二人とも気をつけて！
フォギーは周辺の魔力を吸収し、
さらなる力を得ているようです！
